notes.title: [Steam Next Fest Demo Patch Notes] 06.11
notes.notes:
Fixes：
Fixed Heretic can't use skill for himself.
Optimizations
Magician check optimization:​​ If a player doesn't select a target during the investigation phase, the system will automatically investigate one player for them. Victory mission will be directly displayed to players.

notes.title: [Steam Next Fest Demo Patch Notes] 06.10
notes.notes:
Fixes:
Fixed an issue where props/guns could not be used in the first round.

Fixed incorrect name display for images in the Gallery feature.

Fixed abnormal HP bar display errors.

Fixed abnormal skill trigger display errors.

Fixed an issue where the music button disappeared after creating a room and returning.

Fixed incorrect lobby and battle background music playback.
Optimizations:
Reduced match duration from 120s to 60s.

Adjusted disconnection prompts.

Optimized loading times.

notes.title: "One More Bang" Steam Next Fest Demo Big Update!
notes.notes:
Hey fellow Bang players, we know you've been waiting! One More Bang is back for the Steam Next Fest, running from ​​June 09 to June 16, 2025 (PT)​​. To mark this event, we're rolling out another significant update! Just search ​​"One More Bang"​​ in the Steam Store to find the page and download the Demo.



If this is your first time trying our game, a big welcome! Remember, ​​this demo will remain playable even after the festival ends​​, so you can jump back in anytime.

​​About This Next Fest Demo (For Existing Demo Players):​

​
📢Here's the latest on what's new:
​​3D Gallery​ Adjustment​

​​2D Gallery​ Opening​

​​Match UI Adjustments & Optimizations​​

​​Reconnection Feature & Network Optimizations​​

​​Improved Beginner Tutorial & Key In-Game Information Display​​

​​Music & Sound Effect Optimizations​

​
​​✨Important Note for Demo Players:​​
Please be aware that ​​the game is still under development​​. While playing this demo version, you might encounter:

Events that feel difficult or impossible to complete.

Story dialogue/text that feels underdeveloped or too simplistic.

Missing translations or placeholder text.

Various other unfinished elements.

We appreciate your understanding regarding these aspects.


​​📝Feedback & Community:​​
You can report bugs or discuss the game's details with other enthusiasts by joining our ​​Official Discord: Join us on Discord​​ and send a screenshot of your review via private message to ​​"Tyrek"​​ or DM any of ​​Tide Game’s​​ social media accounts.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536418/4051347f062368cfd90d4f6e3c5f9c2b37c37d60.jpg"]

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0604, 2025
notes.notes:
Dear Players,​​

To ensure a smooth participation in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, ​​"One More Bang"​​ will undergo server maintenance ​​this afternoon​​.

​​Maintenance Schedule:​​
📅 ​​June 4, 2025​​
⏰ ​​00:00 – 04:00 (PT)​​

✨ Key Improvements:
​​Upgraded Server Infrastructure:​​ Expanded the server lobby from a single server to ​​multiple servers​​. This reduces individual server load and ensures a smoother gameplay experience during the event.

🚀 Upcoming Update Preview
Ahead of the festival, we will release a content optimization update, including:


 ​​Enhanced Core Combat Music​​: Remake soundtrack for deeper immersion.
 ​​Revamped Illustrated Archives & Gallery System​​: Complete redesign + new gallery feature.
 ​​Dynamic In-Game Notifications​​: Improved real-time battle feedback.
 ​​Optimized Disconnection Handling​​: More reliable reconnection.
 ​​Improved Information Readability​​: Adjusted more timing for clearer on-screen messaging.



Thank you for your patience and support!

Let’s make One More Bang shine at Steam Next Fest!

notes.title: Update for May 28, 2025
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, a new patch has been released today.

Based on your feedback, we've worked the following fixes:


 localization errors. 
 Several minor bug fixes.
 Default Volume 50
 New MVP animation.
 We are currently working on translation (Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian and more) but it will be available in a future update..


​​Future Development Plans:
Network connection issues have been an extremely challenging obstacle for our small indie develop team. Despite repeatedly trying numerous solutions, some players still remain stuck at the game's start screen. We won't give up! We'll keep working tirelessly to resolve this. We ask for your trust and patience.


Feel free to join the Discord if you encounter any problems.

Have Fun!
